gen-gf-mate-fs-bespoke-sans: Bookish and refined, Mate leads with softly swelling curves. Bespoke Sans keeps generous gaps between curve ends and stems, so paragraphs of it move along smoothly with barely any shift in line thickness.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-ranade: Showy and widely spaced, Metamorphous takes the stage. Its soft fat-and-slim strokes make a statement, while Ranade, with barely shifting weight and far-apart stroke ends, simply carries the text along.
gen-gf-nova-mono-work-sans: Technical and exact, Nova Mono stamps out every curve. Work Sans, with its high mean line and c tips that never drift toward touching, would read smoothly and openly down a full page of text.
gen-gf-offside-fs-fira-sans: Loose, restless and wide-tracked: that's Offside. The standout quality is the tension between Offside's curves that refuse to close and Fira Sans, which has no thick-thin contrast at all and a large x-height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana opens its counters wide and friendly. The big draw is the jump from Tilt Neon, with its tube-like constant-width strokes and splayed c, down to that open, approachable text.
gen-gf-ubuntu-mono-fs-erode: Crisp and structured, Ubuntu Mono has no hairlines at all. What stands out is how Erode, a text serif whose weight gently ebbs and flows, adds dignity and a sensible thick-thin difference against it.
gen-gf-unlock-fs-paquito: Bold, spaced-out and expressive, Unlock sets a measured beat. Paquito, confident yet approachable, with little gap between its x-height and caps, takes over from Unlock's slight pinch and is happiest in sips.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-aclonica: Loud, cheerful strips of ink: Luckiest Guy cuts every glyph to equal width. And Aclonica, a sans-serif with a deep lowercase midsection and a moderate stroke shift, reads steadily and smoothly across paragraph after paragraph.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Loud, cheerful and ribbon-cut, Luckiest Guy grabs the eye. The standout quality is the drop from that constant-width shout to Noto Sans Deseret, with its open apertures and wide-looking squat-ascender lowercase.
gen-megrim-fs-ranade: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with a skyward x-height. Ranade, with weight that shifts only slightly and stroke ends set far apart, reads loosely and smoothly, line after line.
